# Es Venture

> Your boutique digital delivery partner. From bold new ideas to complex digital ecosystems, Es Venture takes diverse digital work and reliably moves it from brief to shipped.

Es Venture is the personal practice of Esther - a boutique digital delivery partner who helps founders and teams structure bold ambitions, hold the thread across web, content and brand, and get complex digital work shipped. The site operates as a one-page "User Manual": visitors scroll through a structured narrative that explains when to reach out, what kinds of work Esther takes on, and how to start a project.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of services, client logos, project planner, and contact.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): Data handling and privacy terms.
- [Style Guide](/styleguide): Brand colors, typography, and component reference.
